title: Machine Learning Engineer (New Grad)
text:
We are looking for a New Grad Machine Learning Engineer to join our applied ML team.

Responsibilities:
- Build and evaluate ML models for text classification and information extraction.
- Ship features to production and monitor their performance.
- Collaborate with product and data teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, or a related field.
- Strong programming in Python; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Familiarity with NLP and the Hugging Face Transformers library.
- Comfortable with Git and Linux.

Preferred:
- Experience with Docker and AWS.
- Exposure to scikit-learn and Pandas.

About us: Acme AI is a sample company used only for TailorVoice demos. This posting is synthetic.
